title: Page search opens with the 'Search or ask a question' box
permissions_required: Any signed-in user of the ShopView App. Whether search results are scoped by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Some sample work orders, customers, assets, parts and vendors exist.
steps: 1. From anywhere in the app, open the page search (the Search box in the top bar, or press Command-K / Ctrl-K).
2. Look at the search panel that opens.
expected: 1. A search panel opens with an empty search box at the top.
2. The box shows the placeholder text 'Search or ask a question' with a magnifier icon on the left and a clear (X) button on the right.
3. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (whether 'ask a question' means an AI search — this is out of scope for now).
notes: Design-only. The 'ask a question' placeholder implies AI, which is out of scope; confirm live once available. OVERLAP: this page-search / Command-K component is also covered by the Global Search project (86 cases already authored there, currently postponed). Reconcile / de-duplicate with Global Search before any TestRail push so the same component is not tested twice. OWNERSHIP (tech plan 2026-07-29 G8/D22, deltas C6): this spotlight/command palette component is the separate Global Search v2 project, NOT the Filters programme - Filters ships a small page-toolbar search instead (see the Page Search Toolbar section, FLT-PSRCH-01..07). Recommend transferring/retiring this case from the Filters suite once Branko answers the page-search-scope question (PO Q6, sent 2026-07-27). | HELD + CONTRADICTION FLAGGED 2026-07-31: spec v1.6 Story 13 (Confluence v12, 2026-07-28) describes page search as an in-toolbar field that expands in place and narrows ONLY the current table (S13-R4/R9/R12/R22), with the placeholder 'Type to search' - NOT the palette with entity tabs, grouped counts and recent searches this case describes. These 9 cases therefore contradict the ratified Filters spec and read as Global Search v2. They are LOCAL-ONLY (blank C-id, never pushed to TestRail, not in run 352), so no tester can hit the contradiction. HELD, not deleted or reworded, per the user ruling of 2026-07-31 - awaiting Branko's ownership confirmation.
